request.query: Personal identity code from a Vero tax office

sources.title: vero.fi
highlights: You can request a identity code from the Tax Administration if you need it for tax-related reasons when you start working in Finland
If you need a personal identity code and a tax card or tax number, you need to visit a service point
The processing time is usually 1 to 3 business days
To book an appointment, call the Tax Administration’s telephone service at 029 497 010 (if you are calling from abroad, +358 29 497 010
a valid passport or official proof of identity with a photograph, from which you can be easily identified
an employment contract if you work for an employer who pays you wages
Make sure to fill in the registration form in advance: Registration information on a foreigner staying in Finland temporarily (6150e
If you are staying in Finland for more than 6 months: Application for tax card, tax prepayment or tax number – current or former foreign residents (5042e

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: You can also receive a personal identity code for tax purposes by visiting Vero’s service desk
You can call the Tax Administration’s telephone service at +358 29 497 010 (Mon–Fri, 9–16) to book an appointment to get a Finnish personal identity code and a tax card at the same time
The Tax Administration (Vero) serves customers on weekdays from 9:00 to 16:00

sources.title: relocateineurope.com
highlights: Tax offices in larger cities issue codes for tax purposes only, usually within one to three business days

sources.title: relocateineurope.com
highlights: A code from Migri or the tax office does not give you a kotikunta
